verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents running a local or dev instance of the Elastic Observability platform itself. Running Elastic Agent in a container is about the data-collection agent, not the platform. The 'open source' and 'open by design' claims are general positioning, not documented self-hosting or local-instance instructions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a local or dev instance of the platform to test instrumentation and dashboards
